resources.string: Drawing from images
Vectorize an image, turn it into a stencil and draw over it.
Add an image
Add an image: a photo, a sketch or a ready-made drawing. Here we use a teapot.
Vectorize the image
Select the image and tap \"Auto-vectorize\" under Edit. Its edges become vector lines with editable points.
Three types, fine tuning
\"Vectorize edges\" keeps the outlines, \"Vectorize lines\" follows a sketch\'s center lines. Detail and smoothing are in the sheet below. Delete the image and only the lines remain.
Make it a stencil
Open Shape template and tap the lines: the drawing becomes a see-through stencil. Move and resize it with the handles.
Draw with the stencil
Draw near the stencil\'s edge: your pen follows it and the line stays steady. Tap Lock so the stencil stays in place.
Stencils from the library
Tap \"From library\" and pick a shape: a cat, a star, a heart and more. Tap Finish to return to normal drawing.
Draw with stencils
Pick a shape and draw along its edge.
Pick a stencil
Tap Stencil and pick a shape. It shows faintly on the canvas.
Draw along the edge
Draw close to the shape\'s edge: your pen follows the line by itself!
